source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.
input_text: Problémy v EPA jsou odlišné, ale nikoli nesouvisející s problémům v ministerstvu spravedlnosti, které řeší trestné zločiny proti životnímu prostředí prostřednictvím svého odboru životního prostředí a přírodních zdrojů (ENRD). Před nástupem do EPA působil Uhlmann – asistent tajemníka EPA pro vymáhání – jako dlouholetý šéf sekce ekologických zločinů této divize, a to v letech 1990 až 2007. EPA posílá své nejzávažnější občanskoprávní a trestněprávní případy ENRD, která – jako relativně nedostatečně financovaný úřad – často spoléhá na to, že jí ostatní agentury pomohou vybrat, do jakých bojů se pustit. source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Před nástupem do EPA byl Uhlmann, asistent tajemníka EPA pro prosazování práva, v letech 1990 až 2007 dlouholetým vedoucím sekce ekologických trestných činů této divize. EPA zasílá své nejzávažnější občanské a trestní případy ENRD, která – jako relativně nedostatečně financovaný úřad – se často spoléhá na pomoc jiných agentur při rozhodování, které spory má řešit. Ve fiskálním roce 2022 EPA odložila méně případů ministerstvu spravedlnosti (88) než v jakémkoli roce od roku 2000 a uzavřela méně občanskoprávních soudních případů než kdykoli od té doby. Jak projekt Environmentální integrity Project upozorňuje, i Trumpovo EPA uzavřelo v průměru 94 občanskoprávních případů a ročně odložilo ministerstvu spravedlnosti 106 případů.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Před nástupem do EPA působil Uhlmann, náměstek ministra pro vymáhání práva v EPA, jako dlouholetý vedoucí oddělení pro environmentální zločiny v tomto oddělení od roku 1990 do roku 2007. EPA předává své nejzávažnější občanskoprávní a trestní případy ENRD, které - jako relativně nedostatečně financované úřady - často spoléhají na pomoc jiných agentur při rozhodování, které případy přijmout. V fiskálním roce 2022 EPA předala méně případů Ministerstvu spravedlnosti (88) než kdykoli dříve od roku 2000 a uzavřela méně občanskoprávních soudních případů než kdykoli dříve od té doby. Jak poznamenává Environmental Integrity Project, i Trumpova EPA uzavřela v průměru 94 občanskoprávních případů a předala 106 případů ročně Ministerstvu spravedlnosti.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Jak poznamenává Projekt environmentální integrity, dokonce Trumpova EPA uzavřela 94 civilních případů a odložila 106 případů ročně k DOJ ročně, v průměru.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well. As the Environmental Integrity Project notes, even Trump's EPA concluded 94 civil cases and deferred 106 cases per year to the DOJ per year, on average.

Před nástupem do EPA působil Uhlmann, náměstek ministra pro vymáhání práva v EPA, jako dlouholetý vedoucí oddělení pro environmentální zločiny v tomto oddělení od roku 1990 do roku 2007. EPA předává své nejzávažnější občanskoprávní a trestní případy ENRD, které - jako relativně nedostatečně financované úřady - často spoléhají na pomoc jiných agentur při rozhodování, které případy přijmout. V fiskálním roce 2022 EPA předala méně případů Ministerstvu spravedlnosti (88) než kdykoli dříve od roku 2000 a uzavřela méně občanskoprávních soudních případů než kdykoli dříve od té doby. Jak poznamenává Environmental Integrity Project, i Trumpova EPA uzavřela v průměru 94 občanskoprávních případů a předala 106 případů ročně Ministerstvu spravedlnosti.

source_text: The problems at the EPA are distinct but not unrelated to those at the Department of Justice, which handles environmental crimes via its Environment and Natural Resources Division, or ENRD. Prior to joining the EPA, Uhlmann - the EPA assistant secretary for enforcement - had served as the longtime head of that division's Environmental Crimes Section, from 1990 through 2007. The EPA sends its most serious civil and criminal cases to ENRD, which - as a relatively underfunded office - often relies on other agencies in helping to choose which fights to take on. In fiscal year 2022, the EPA deferred fewer cases to DOJ (88) than at any point since 2000 and concluded fewer civil judicial cases than it had since that time, as well.
